[[File:Shigormallan.jpg|thumb|right|217px|Shigormallan during a briefing]]
'''Mishowan Shigormallan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]]. As a teenager, he joined a crew of [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo haulers]]. He was constantly being chased by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], and decided to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] when he met a group of Alliance field agents. He completed his training in the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]] division and was put in the [[Pathfinder-class scout ship|Pathfinders]] regiment. He quickly became a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], and he was transferred to [[Taskforce Shen]]. He led a Pathfinder platoon under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Mart Stevez]].<ref name="RoE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
